content:
alice: Quick heads-up — nightly perf alerts show a p99 spike after the main merge, baseline ~45ms -> ~210ms. CI perf canary failed, need a bisect ASAP.
ci-bot: perf-ci/nightly failed: runtime-p99=210ms (>3x), build: https://ci/redwood/12345, job: runtime-perf-canary.
bob: I'm on it. I'll start a git bisect against the perf harness. Which commits should I use for good/bad?
alice: Good commit: abc123 (2024-03-01) p99=45ms. Bad: HEAD (post-merge). Repro steps: ./tools/perf_harness --model small --seq 512 --parallel 16 --duration 300. Use perf profile level=2.
bob: Thanks. Running local harness now. Quick note: I suspect the prefetch change from PR #4729 touched kernel selector thresholds.
carla: I looked at a flamegraph from last night — hotspots in kv_cache::evict_path and kernel_selector::score_cost overlapping. Could be an interaction where eviction timing increases kernel selection overhead.
dave: I can reproduce locally. With default warmup disabled p99 jumps to ~220ms; with warmup=true p99 goes back to ~48ms. So cache warmup/eviction timing matters.
bob: Starting git bisect now with the harness:
```
git bisect start HEAD abc123
git bisect run ./tools/perf_bisect.sh
```
ci-bot: Perf harness environment reminder: set RUNTIME_PREFETCH=1 and RUNTIME_PREFETCH_DEPTH=4 for parity with nightlies.
bob: First bisect results: commit 7f4c9e286 is showing as bad (reproduces higher p99). Narrowing down.
carla: Wait — 7f4c9e2 also touches kernel_selector scoring weights in addition to kv eviction window? I thought the scoring tweak was separate.
bob: Looking at the diff: 7f4c9e2 modifies kv/eviction.cc and runtime/kernel_selector.cc in the same commit — that would explain the interaction.
alice: If bisect confirms, plan is revert 7f4c9e2 on canary, validate perf, then split the logic into two PRs so we can land the safe part. Who can do the revert? :thumbsup:
dave: I can prepare the revert PR and run the canary perf. I'll also run the harness with toggles: --prefetch=off and --kv-evict-threshold=old to confirm which toggle mitigates.
carla: Also will add a regression guard in the perf suite asserting p99 < 80ms for the small-model profile to catch this earlier.
alice: Action items: bob finish the full bisect (ETA 30m), dave create revert PR + canary runs, carla add perf test, I'll coordinate the canary rollback and incident notes.
bob: Bisect finished — culprit confirmed: 7f4c9e286d2b (kv + kernel selector changes). Repro log and bisect output uploaded to #eng-runtime (link: https://internal/links/bisect-1982103344).
ci-bot: Created ticket PERF-428 for tracking the regression and rollback steps.
alice: Thanks everyone. Please ping here when the revert PR is open and when canary metrics are collected. Marking this thread as rollout-blocker.
